Mira Tolliver trained under old Ferran Voss, who also taught Odo. Mira was born in Harrowgate.

Brannoch Ashe was a smith. His younger sister, Lenna, kept the forge. Lenna's husband, Pell, ran the cart.

Cerro Maddox, a cousin of Lenna, lived by the river.

Corvin Hale hunted wolves in the north. Old stories say his family was cursed. His brother, Daric, vanished at forty.
